svg.title: BOOSTER's immunization record: one stamp per planned hop
svg.desc: Form B-01 · Version immunization record. examples/laravel-blade. A short countdown, then a stamp lands on each hop BOOSTER plans, one row at a time: laravel-10-to-11 (PHP 8.2 · Laravel 11, gate passed); laravel-11-to-12 (PHP 8.2 · Laravel 12, gate passed); php-82-to-83 (PHP 8.3 · Laravel 12, gate passed); laravel-12-to-13 (PHP 8.3 · Laravel 13, gate passed); php-83-to-84 (PHP 8.4 · Laravel 13, gate passed); php-84-to-85 (PHP 8.5 · Laravel 13, gate passed). RESULT: PASS. Review with git diff, run your own checks, then commit. BOOSTER never commits or pushes.
